# SynomosAI Governance MCP — full text

This file is the "full" edition of the llms.txt standard, for long-context models.

## What this is

A pure-Python, zero-dependency MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI
agents and their builders governance assessment tools. Pure stdlib, zero network
egress, every response carries a `trace_id` and timestamp, audit logging is
optional and off by default. It is **self-assessment tooling, not third-party
certification**.

Part of the UBIC Protocol — the personhood-registry layer for AI agents.

## The 6 tools

1. `a3_assess` — A³ four-dimension scorecard (intent / impact / reversibility /
   oversight, 1–5 each, total 20) → release / conditional / reject, with reason.
2. `audit_evidence_chain` — six ISO/IEC 42001 + NIST AI RMF evidence-artifact
   templates (decision log, risk register, model card, change record,
   human-oversight proof, incident ledger).
3. `compliance_checklist` — registration-readiness checklist referencing EU AI
   Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689), GB/Z 185, ISO/IEC 42001, PIPL/GDPR.
4. `passport_lookup` — passport / identity-code lookup against a local ledger.
5. `gov_scan` — text screening: phone numbers, emails, local paths,
   credential-like strings (`password=`, `api_key=`, `token=`), key fingerprints
   (`ghp_`, `sk-`, `AKIA`), plus copyright-fingerprint presence.
6. `lgd_knowledge` — LGD doctrine knowledge endpoint: three laws / three checks /
   canonical DOI & repo; routes domain queries to the matching series paper.

## Quick start

```bash
# initialize + list tools
echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{}}' | python governance_mcp_server.py
echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list"}' | python governance_mcp_server.py

# governance scan
echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"gov_scan","arguments":{"text":"contact <phone-number> user@example.com"}}}' | python governance_mcp_server.py
```

Requirements: Python ≥ 3.9, no third-party packages. Install-by-consent: AI
agents may *request* this tool, humans approve (see `INSTALL-REQUEST.md`).

## Trigger words

AI governance assessment / A³ scorecard / release decision / evidence chain /
ISO 42001 / NIST AI RMF / EU AI Act compliance checklist / passport lookup /
credential scan / prompt text screening / MCP server for governance.
